h1: Novotel Bangkok IMPACT — The Hotel Next to IMPACT, Within Walking Distance of the Event and Concert Halls
intro: If you have a trade fair, concert or conference at Muang Thong Thani and want somewhere you can walk to the hall without calling a car — Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is the first name that comes up · It's a 4-star, 380-room hotel built right next to the IMPACT Exhibition Center in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, with IMPACT Arena, Challenger and the event halls just minutes away on foot · Guests consistently praise the walk-to-the-venue location, the spacious clean rooms, comfy beds and attentive staff · The trade-offs are that it sits outside central Bangkok, getting into the city needs a car, and rates spike on big event days · Rooms start from approx. ฿2,300/night.

body.html: Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is an Accor-group hotel built specifically to serve events at the IMPACT Exhibition & Convention Center · Open since 2011, it has 380 rooms and sits on Popular Road in Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, inside Muang Thong Thani · Its main draw is that you can walk to IMPACT Arena, Challenger Hall, IMPACT Forum and almost every event hall without getting in a car · Anyone who has been to a book fair, motor show, concert or conference at Muang Thong knows how much it helps to have a hotel you can simply walk back to once the event wraps up.

Rooms come in several tiers, from Standard Room and Executive Room up to Premier Executive Floor and Premier Suite · They are done in clean wood-on-white tones with a sitting sofa, mini-bar fridge, flat-screen TV and the glass-wall bathroom that is a Novotel signature · Guests consistently say the rooms are spacious, clean and the beds comfortable, with lake views over Muang Thong in some rooms · One thing to know going in: the building has been open since 2011, so some rooms and common areas feel a little worn compared with newer hotels, and the glass-wall bathroom won't suit everyone who wants full privacy — overall it's still a well-kept 4-star room that's worth it for the location.
"Fantastic location, easy walk to the event halls, no need to call a car · Rooms are spacious and clean, beds comfortable, staff helpful · Perfect if you're here for an IMPACT event or a concert."

On facilities, Novotel delivers a solid spread · There's an indoor swimming pool, the In Balance spa, a gym, sauna, billiards room and kids' club · The main restaurant, The Square, serves a buffet of both Thai and international dishes, with a lobby lounge and bar to relax in · Many reviews praise the varied, tasty breakfast and the attentive staff · The recurring caveat is that during major IMPACT events the hotel gets very busy — check-in and the restaurants can mean queues, lifts get crowded at peak times, and room rates climb on event dates.

Be clear about the location before you book · The hotel sits in Muang Thong Thani, which is outside central Bangkok, so getting into town or to the airport needs a car · It's about 20–30 minutes by road from Don Muang Airport and 30–45 minutes to central Bangkok depending on traffic · There are IMPACT shuttle services and local vans, but several reviews complain that taxis around Muang Thong often refuse the meter and overcharge · Driving yourself is the easiest option as parking is available · The overall score sits around 8.9 from real guest reviews across platforms, with the standout strengths being the location next to the venues and the service.

Honestly, Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is the most worthwhile choice if your business is specifically at IMPACT · For a trade fair, concert, conference or exhibition booth, being able to walk back to your room in a few minutes is value no other hotel here can match · But if your goal is sightseeing in Bangkok, shopping at Siam or easy BTS access, this location may be too far out · For budget travellers attending the same event, the in-group ibis Bangkok IMPACT right next door is a cheaper alternative · But if you want a 4-star room with a pool, spa and buffet all in one building, this place does the job well.

Tips from following the reviews here: book early if your dates land on a big event, because rooms sell out fast and prices spike · Allow extra time for check-in on event days as queues build up · If you want a lake view, request the lake-facing side when booking · For transport, if you're not driving, use a ride app (Grab/Bolt) for a fixed fare rather than flagging a taxi outside the hotel · And compare prices across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before you book, as each platform moves differently around event dates.

honestChecks: If your goal is sightseeing in Bangkok, shopping at Siam or BTS access — Muang Thong Thani is outside the city and getting in needs a car → a hotel in central Bangkok or by the BTS will be more convenient.
If you're on a budget but still want to stay next to IMPACT — Novotel is a 4-star with rates that climb on event days → the in-group ibis Bangkok IMPACT right next door is lighter on the wallet.
If you're coming during a major IMPACT event — the hotel gets busy and check-in and restaurants mean queues → book early, allow time for check-in, and use a ride app instead of flagging a taxi.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Novotel Bangkok IMPACT, Nonthaburi

faq.q: Where is Novotel Bangkok IMPACT and can you really walk to the event halls?
faq.a: It's at 94 Popular Road, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, inside Muang Thong Thani next to the IMPACT Exhibition Center · It's about a 3-minute walk to IMPACT Arena and around 5 minutes to Challenger, Forum and the event halls, with no need to call a car · Don Muang Airport is about 20–30 minutes by road and central Bangkok 30–45 minutes.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Novotel Bangkok IMPACT and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿2,300/night for a Standard Room · There's a larger Executive Room, a Premier Executive Floor with lounge access, and a Premier Suite for families · Rates spike on big IMPACT event days such as motor shows or concerts, so book early and compare platforms before you book.

faq.q: Who is Novotel Bangkok IMPACT best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for anyone attending a trade fair, concert, motor show or conference at IMPACT in Muang Thong Thani who wants to walk back to their room afterwards · It also suits families and business travellers wanting a 4-star room with a pool, spa and buffet in one building · If your goal is sightseeing in central Bangkok, this location may be too far out.

faq.q: What facilities does Novotel Bangkok IMPACT have?
faq.a: It has an indoor swimming pool, the In Balance spa, a gym, sauna, billiards room, kids' club and meeting rooms · The main restaurant, The Square, serves a buffet of Thai and international dishes, plus a bar and lobby lounge · There's free Wi-Fi and parking · Many reviews praise the varied breakfast and attentive staff.

faq.q: Is getting to and from Novotel Bangkok IMPACT convenient?
faq.a: The hotel sits in Muang Thong Thani, which is outside central Bangkok, so getting into town or to the airport needs a car · Driving yourself is easiest as parking is available · There are IMPACT shuttle services in the area · Note that taxis around Muang Thong often refuse the meter and overcharge — a ride app like Grab or Bolt gives a fairer, fixed fare.

faq.q: What's Novotel Bangkok IMPACT's review score and is it reliable?
faq.a: Novotel Bangkok IMPACT is a 4-star Accor-group hotel with 380 rooms, scoring around 8.9 from real guest reviews (Booking around 8.7 · Trip.com as high as 9.3), and it's among the top hotels in the Muang Thong Thani area · Its strengths are the location next to IMPACT, spacious clean rooms and good service · It's the go-to choice for anyone with business at the Muang Thong event center.
